proves.claim: verdictIsolation is true when the check ran in the board-made review folder, or when a runner receipt at the submitted commit backs it, and false otherwise.

cli.io-commands-verify.isolated-flag.why: Without it, a verdict could not say whether its check ran in the reviewer's own checkout or in an isolated copy of the commit.

proves.claim: A review of a submitted item runs its frozen check in the board-made review folder at the submitted commit, and the verdict it records reads verdict_isolated true in board_meta.

cli.journeys-verify-main.review-in-board.why: Without it, a review could pass on files in the reviewer's own checkout that the submitted commit does not hold.

proves.claim: A review folder whose node_modules links to another checkout is refused DEPS_OUTSIDE_TREE naming the package, before the frozen check runs and with no verdict recorded.

cli.journeys-verify-main.linked-deps-ref.why: Without it, a symlinked dependency would make a review read code that is not the commit under review.

proves.claim: The runner receipt for a review tree carries the submitted commit, its tree, and the sha256 of the tree's lockfile.

cli.journeys-verify-main.receipt-tree-an.why: Without it, a verdict could not show which tree and dependencies its proof ran against.
